title: A1 Level Final Exam
description: Test your knowledge of Past Simple, Future, Comparatives, Modal verbs, Present Perfect, Past Continuous, Conditionals Type 0/1, Passive Voice, Gerunds, Used to

exercises.instruction: Fill in the past simple form (regular and irregular).

items.sentence: She ___ (work) in a bank last year.
Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
I ___ buy a new car next year. (plan)

exercises.instruction: Fill in must, mustn't, should, shouldn't, have to.

items.sentence: You ___ stop at a red light.
You ___ see a doctor. You look ill.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the present perfect form.
Fill in the two missing words.

items.sentence: I have lived here ___ five years.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the past continuous form.

items.sentence: She ___ (walk) home when it started to rain.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the correct forms (first conditional).

items.sentence: If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we ___ (stay) at home.
If you ___ (study) hard, you ___ (pass) the exam.
They built the Eiffel Tower in 1889. → The Eiffel Tower ___

exercises.instruction: Fill in the gerund or infinitive.
Fill in used to or didn't use to.

items.sentence: I ___ play the piano when I was a child.
She ___ like coffee, but now she loves it.

items.source: Я был в Лондоне два раза.
items.target: I have been to London twice.

items.source: Я смотрел телевизор, когда ты позвонил.
items.target: I was watching TV when you called.

items.source: Если завтра пойдёт дождь, я останусь дома.
items.target: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
